product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides a cloud platform for software teams to test web and mobile applications across real devices, browsers, and emulators, with AI-assisted test authoring and release assurance.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes cross-browser/mobile testing and AURA.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page with prices and plans.

named_customers.notes: Each named organization appears in Sauce Labs customer case studies.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company profile identifies San Francisco headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company profile lists year founded as 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains multiple substantive technical posts on device APIs, test-authoring implementation, and engineering AI workflows.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation site has many product and API articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Official current job board lists an open AI Architect role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public Sauce AI documentation, including privacy/safety materials, and found no named AI model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center search result identifies SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 among certifications. Other named certifications such as ISO 27701 or ISO 42001 are not included because the requested list is limited to SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Sauce Labs announced a $50 million growth investment on March 26, 2019; funding databases list this as the latest disclosed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent reported funding round is from March 2019, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official job board lists Account Executive and Inside Sales Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Sauce Labs announced the AURA product launch on 2026-07-22, within six months of the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Announcement dated April 16, 2026 reports CRO Steven Fitz and SVP Global Marketing Arun Lal joining Sauce Labs.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The VP Sales listing explicitly references Salesforce CRM inspection and pipeline metrics.
